title: Hub Aggregates Spoke Metadata on Wakeup via Registry-Refresh Skill
description: Hub's registry-refresh skill runs on wakeup, reads all active spokes' .spoke-metadata.yaml files, and aggregates into the live hub/registry.yaml. Registry is always current because it's built from source of truth (spoke self-declarations).
perceive: Help system needs to route questions to the right expert. Routing depends on accurate registry. Registry goes stale if manually edited.
execute: Created framework/skills/hub-registry-refresh.yaml. Runs on hub wakeup. Reads all spokes' .spoke-metadata.yaml, aggregates into hub/registry.yaml. Detects changes and logs them.
verify: hub/registry.yaml is always current, reflects all active spokes, includes activity metrics for BI.
resolution_reason: Hub never manually edits registry. Hub only aggregates spoke self-declarations. Registry stays current through automation.
